name: hubs_vs_leaves
title: Hub writes vs person analytics
why: nhop2 reads only knows lists (Chunked: {ch_nhop2} ops per run against {sp_nhop2} for Split); the inserts never touch knows, they append to hub lists (a country's isLocatedIn list, a tag's hasTag list), where Split writes 2 small keys and Condensed / Chunked rewrite the whole list or chunk (an isLocatedIn list part averages {loc_part} under Condensed). No part carries both kinds of traffic, so a mixed layout gets the Chunked read cost and the Split write cost together.

why_scale_free.2: one new record per direction of the edge (schema)
